svg.title: Save, reload and evaluate an LLM adapter
svg.desc: The original base weights and tokenizer remain unchanged. After training, the agent retains adapter weights and configuration. The agent reloads the adapter with the compatible base LLM and compares this configuration with the unadapted baseline on the same held-out cases, using selected prompts and recorded generation settings. Both response files retain case identifiers for scoring against human reference labels.
svg.text: Reload the saved adapter before evaluating it
Match case IDs and compare errors
Score both against the reference labels
The adapter is used with its compatible base LLM
